_comment: X = total {h} gained this turn -> LIFE_GAINED_THIS_TURN, tallied by gain() at the single point life actually rises. This is a MAGNITUDE, so a turn-event marker could not carry it — markers count occurrences, not amounts. Was the invented string 'TOTAL_HEALTH_GAINED_THIS_TURN' resolving to 0, so the card created no Runechants at all.
